1-trace.production_problem: After applying a percentage promo code on the cart page, changing an item quantity reduced the order total a second time (19% off instead of 10% for SPRING10). 37 orders were affected between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-14. It was detected by the finance team's daily discount reconciliation, not by customers [issue:SHOP-482] [production-learning.md].

links.basis: The production issue records an 'is caused by' link to SHOP-455.
links.verified_support: recorded issue link: SHOP-482 is caused by SHOP-455 (DIRECT)

links.evidence_quote: SHOP-455 apply promo codes on the cart page
links.basis: The pull request title names SHOP-455, and the story comment says it was merged in PR #318.
The CI results and the pull request show the same commit 4f2c1a9e.
Same feature area; TC-210 is automated as test_promo_applies_percentage, which the pull request adds.
The release record lists SHOP-455 as a work item.

timeline.event: Pricing rules document says percentage discounts are calculated from the undiscounted subtotal.
QA engineer asks on SHOP-455 what happens to the discount when a quantity changes after a code is applied.
CI unit suite passes at commit 4f2c1a9e.
PR #318 merged.
Regression run RUN-77 closes: TC-210 and TC-212 passed; TC-211 not run.
Release 4.2.0 approved with a note that quantity edits after applying a code are not covered.
Release 4.2.0 deployed to production.
Finance reconciliation flags discounts above the promo percentage.
SHOP-482 opened.
Fix PR #331 merged.

known_before_release: The pricing rules required discounts to be calculated from the undiscounted subtotal [documentation.md].
A QA question about quantity changes after applying a code was recorded on SHOP-455 and has no recorded answer [issue:SHOP-455].
The release approval note stated that quantity edits after applying a code were not covered, with follow-up SHOP-470 [release:4.2.0].
learned_after_release: The discount was applied a second time after a quantity change; 37 orders were affected [issue:SHOP-482].
The quantity-change hook re-applied the promo to a total that already included the discount [fix-change.md].
ambiguities: Whether the release manager had seen the unanswered QA question on SHOP-455 when approving the release.
Whether SHOP-460, also in release 4.2.0, touched the cart code.
missing_evidence: Production monitoring and alerting configuration for discounts.
Review discussion of PR #318 beyond the approval comment.

critical_signals.description: QA asked what should happen to the discount if a quantity changes after a code is applied; the comment says this is not covered by the acceptance criteria, and no answer is recorded.
The release approval note states that quantity edits after applying a code are not covered in release 4.2.0, with follow-up SHOP-470.

activities.finding: The promo percentage and expired-code checks were automated in the unit suite; no automated test changes a quantity after applying a code.
activities.evidence_status_reason: References resolve, but the activity interpretation has no independently verified semantic support.

activities.finding: PR #318 changed cart/events.py so that the discount is recalculated on any cart change, which is wider than the story's acceptance criteria describe.
activities.evidence_status_reason: References resolve, but the activity interpretation has no independently verified semantic support.

activities.finding: TC-211 was not run in RUN-77.
activities.evidence_status_reason: References resolve, but the activity interpretation has no independently verified semantic support.

activities.finding: The release decision recorded the uncovered quantity-edit condition and approved the release with a follow-up.
activities.evidence_status_reason: References resolve, but the activity interpretation has no independently verified semantic support.

2-validation.test_coverage_failure_mode: 1. No relevant test existed: the recorded tests apply a code to an unchanged cart, reload the page, or use an expired code; none changes a quantity after applying a code.
2-validation.ci_evidence_provided: junit:ci-unit shows three unit tests passing at commit 4f2c1a9e. test_quantity_update_changes_total exercises a quantity change without a promo code. No CI result exercises a quantity change after a code is applied.
release_signals: Release approval note: quantity edits after applying a code are not covered in this release; follow-up SHOP-470 (signal-002).
missing_evidence: Whether SHOP-470 was scheduled or worked before the incident.

hypotheses.statement: PR #318 calculates the discount from the cart total after discounts and re-applies it when a quantity changes, so a second discount is taken from an already-discounted total.
